name: Auer Camp
description_short: A farm-based day camp on a 120-acre farm in Bloomfield, CT, for ages 3-15. Summer 2027 runs for 7 weeks, June 21 to August 6, with a S.T.E.A.M. curriculum built around farm animals, gardening, nature exploration and arts. Groups run from a half-day Sprouts program (ages 3-5) up to a leadership program for grades 9-10. Registration opens January 1, 2027.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellation fees depend on how much notice you give: $75 for more than 30 days, $200 for 14-30 days, $300 for less than 2 weeks.
special_needs_notes: Sprouts (ages 3-5) must be fully potty-trained. Barn activities are adjusted for each child's age and comfort.
swim_waterfront_notes: No pool or swim program is described. Older campers may explore, fish and play in a stream on the farm.
